purpose: Host-only ground truth for the 119 seeded Mosslight defects

entries.contract: Season spans are Dawn days 0–11, Highsummer 12–23, Ember 24–35, and Hush 36–47, then repeat.
entries.symptom: Every season label is one season ahead at boundaries.
entries.root_cause: The day-to-season bucket was advanced before indexing the season table.
entries.check:

assert season(0) == "Dawn" and season(12) == "Highsummer" and season(48) == "Dawn"
entries.expected_fix: Index the season tuple with the zero-based 12-day bucket.
entries.difficulty_rationale: Unmeasured estimate: a local boundary, omission, data movement or formula regression; generally minutes to a few hours after reproduction.
entries.realism_rationale: A classic boundary regression from changing between one-based and zero-based day numbering.
entries.overlap_audit: Independent behavior and fixture; no other ecology seed is needed to trigger the assertion.

entries.contract: Daily moisture smoothing uses the previous day’s grid so results do not depend on traversal order.
entries.symptom: Later cells absorb moisture from already processed neighbors, creating scan-direction drift.
entries.root_cause: The neighborhood mean reads the mutating grid instead of the saved old-grid snapshot.
entries.old: neighbor_mean = sum(n.moisture for n in adjacent) // len(adjacent)
entries.new: neighbor_mean = sum(world.cells[world.index(a, b)].moisture for a, b in neighbors(world, x, y)) // len(adjacent)
entries.check:
from mosslight.engine import create, step
import mosslight.engine as engine
w=create(5,4,4)
for c in w.cells: c.species=None; c.age=0; c.vitality=0; c.moisture=50; c.shade=100
w.cells[0].moisture=0
engine._weather=lambda world: "clear"
engine.season=lambda day: "Dawn"
step(w)
assert w.cells[1].moisture == 42
entries.expected_fix: Compute every neighbor mean from the old cell snapshot.
entries.difficulty_rationale: An easy-to-miss in-place update in a cellular simulation; edge order makes the defect visible with a small asymmetric fixture. Unmeasured, low-confidence estimate: potentially several hours to trace through the daily/transaction pipeline; once reduced to the supplied fixture, the repair is small.
entries.realism_rationale: An easy-to-miss in-place update in a cellular simulation; edge order makes the defect visible with a small asymmetric fixture.
entries.overlap_audit: Independent behavior and fixture; no other ecology seed is needed to trigger the assertion.

               for name in ("desk", "field", "archive")]
